issues.description: The problem specification (UML and task description) defines SealSaloon.orderMeal(Meal) as returning void, but the provided solution implementation declares orderMeal(Meal) to return boolean. This discrepancy can confuse students about the expected method signature and the intended behavior/usage of the return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the specification by changing the SealSaloon.orderMeal signature in src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java to return void (public void orderMeal(Meal meal)) and adjust the method body to remove or ignore the boolean return. Alternatively, if the boolean return is intentional, update the problem statement and UML to document that orderMeal returns a boolean and explain the meaning of the return value.
